text: Langbourne Place is a local road with two way traffic extending west from The Donway West to a dead end. The speed limit for roads of similar nature in the vicinity is 40 km/h. I have heard from concerned residents about vehicles regularly exceeding the speed limit on Langbourne Place and I am requesting that the speed limit be reduced from 50 km/h to 40 km/h, to bring it in line with its other local roads in North York.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 kilometres per hour to 40 kilometres per hour on Langbourne Place, between The Donway West and the west end of Langbourne Place.
